title: MonoDreams block manifest
description: A block is a self-contained, copyable slice of the MonoDreams engine. Manifests describe the files, dependencies, NuGet packages, csproj/.mgcb edits, and post-install guidance the CLI applies when a user runs `monodreams add <block>`.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema. Conventionally `../block.schema.json` relative to the manifest.

name.description: Block identifier, kebab-case. Must match the directory name under `registry/`.

description.description: Single-line summary shown by `monodreams list`. No trailing period.

dependencies.description: Other blocks this block requires. Resolved transitively at install time.

nugetDependencies.description: NuGet `<PackageReference>` entries the CLI injects into the user's csproj.

csprojProperties.description: Properties the CLI adds to a `<PropertyGroup>` in the user's csproj. Keys are MSBuild property names, values are their text content.

source.description: Path relative to the engine repo root (this repo). Read by the CLI when copying.

destination.description: Path relative to the user's project root where the file lands. By convention mirrors `source` so namespaces and the on-disk path stay aligned.

kind.description: `code` — C# source (default). `asset` — non-compiled resource, copied as-is. `tool` — supporting script (e.g. Blender exporter) dropped under `Tools/`.

files.description: Optional override of the implicit file list. By default the CLI copies every file inside `MonoDreams/<block-name>/` (except `block.json` itself); use this only when a block needs to ship a file from outside its own directory.

mgcbEntries.description: Lines the CLI appends to the user's `.mgcb` file (Content pipeline). Each entry is a complete MGCB statement (e.g. `#begin Fonts/...`).

postInstallNotes.description: Markdown printed to the terminal after install. Use it for `Logger.Initialize(...)` calls, asset hookups, system pipeline order — anything a human or an AI agent needs to wire the block into their screen.

agentsMd.description: Optional path (relative to the manifest) to an AGENTS.md snippet. When present, the CLI appends it to the user's project-root AGENTS.md so AI agents inherit the block's invariants.

premisesRef.description: Path relative to the block manifest, pointing at the `premises.md` for this block. Conventionally `docs/premises.md` (each block ships its own `docs/` subfolder). Surfaced by `monodreams list --verbose` so users and agents know where the invariants live.
